tool_description: Search for movies and film information using the TMDb (The Movie Database) service.

api_list.name: get_movies
api_list.description: Searches for movies based on a keyword and optional release year. Returns a list of matching films including their name, overview, original language, popularity score, and release date

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The search term or movie title to look for (e.g., 'Inception', 'Star Wars').

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The specific release year to filter results (e.g., 2010).

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of movie results to return.
